_transcription: OUTER BOUNDARY of the subdivision (Lots 1 + 2 + the area dedicated to public use). Courses derived from the three corner coordinates the plat publishes to four decimals, which are more precise than its lettered distances. Every course was cross-checked against the plat's own lettering and agrees within 0.16 ft and 10 arc-seconds; the computed area agrees with the recorded total within 1 sq ft of 21,825.
_validation: misclosure 0.0061 ft over 715.26 ft = 1:118,119. Recorded area 21,825 sq ft, computed 21,826. certifiable: true.
